name: Prototype: traverse a train station
body: A level of platforms, stairs, a footbridge, ticket gates (a lever issues a ticket that opens a gate), trains that arrive and leave, signs, and a ladder up from the tracks. Gaps are replaced by places: the way across is a route, not a jump.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the six rooms and the crossing: the game feels like an action adventure (grounded movement, challenge from places and small games), not a puzzle platformer.

acceptance_criteria: Trains pass without trapping the player
A solo route and a with-her route exist
